articles.title: The Secret Superpower of World Cup Songs (It's Not Just Soccer!)
articles.summary: Imagine a song so catchy it broke a world record and helped a singer meet her future husband! Shakira's 'Waka Waka' did both. We dug up the coolest World Cup anthems ever—some you know, some you definitely forgot.

articles.title: We Made a Giant Mess to Find the Best Robot Vacuum—Here's the Winner!
articles.summary: What happens when you scatter flour, rice, and crushed cereal all over the floor? You find out which robot vacuum is a cleaning superhero! We tested the latest bots on carpet, concrete, and laminate to see which one gobbled up the mess best.

articles.title: Overwatch's New Robot Hero Looks Awesome—But Wait, Is That a Human Face?
articles.summary: Meet Shion, the cool new robot hero in Overwatch! She rides a motorcycle and shoots two pistols. But fans noticed something weird: her face looks a lot like other female heroes. Is it a secret story clue, or just a design choice?
